Definition: Adah, the name of two women
BiblicalUsage: Adah = "ornament"; 1) the 1st of the 2 wives of Lamech and mother of Jabal and Jubal; 2) a Hittitess, 1 of the 3 wives of Esau and mother of Eliphaz; 2a) also called 'Bashemath'
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
